instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully responsive React app with Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Implement iTunes Search API integration with mock fallback for robust reliability.
Include personal library CRUD with local storage & backend sync.
Build interactive Recharts analytics dashboard with genre trends, mood distribution, and listening metrics.
Implement AI-driven music recommendations & mood classification engine.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Follow sleek dark mode styling with gorgeous gradients and glassmorphic panels.
universal_guidelines: No transparent headers without backdrop blur
